free_tier: None (no free plan on the website or Discord)
licence_note: Images are public and remixable by default; private (Stealth) from Pro, $60 a month. Companies over $1M revenue need Pro or Mega to own their assets.
test: Desk study from public documentation: plans, Fast-time math, privacy, who it's for.

price_math.note: Docs: one image prompt usually takes about one GPU minute and makes a 4-image grid; SD 0.8 min would give about 250 prompts. Upscales, odd aspect ratios and HD cost more.

flaw.detail: Basic and Standard images are publicly viewable and remixable; Stealth Mode is Pro ($60) and Mega only.

verdict_reason: There's no free plan, so we didn't test it and give it no score. From their own pages: $10 a month buys about 800 images, but everything you make is public unless you pay $60 a month.
use_for: Mood boards you don't mind sharing
lesson: Check who can see your images before you pick a plan: the $10 plan makes everything public.
